design.world_policy: one fresh world per scheduled session; worlds in a block share a seed and all frozen generation settings

automation.world_creation: Prism Toolkit owned ephemeral save shell; Minecraft generates chunks and new-seed spawn
automation.stop_boundary: explicit_stop is written and closed before world exit

explore.instruction: From fresh spawn and an empty inventory, explore for useful terrain and landmarks while keeping a route you can reason about. No destination is prescribed.

acquire.instruction: From fresh spawn and an empty inventory, assemble a personally viable portable survival kit, then return to the spawn area before ending.

construct.instruction: Using only the standardized kit and anything gathered after recording starts, build a compact shelter you consider ready for one survival night.

recover.instruction: Use the standardized kit normally for two minutes, trigger the frozen in-game death setback, then regain or rebuild a viable state and mark recovery when you judge it complete.

markers.plan_started: Emit once after deciding on an initial plan and before substantial task action.
markers.plan_revised: Emit whenever the operative plan materially changes; zero is valid.
markers.setback: For recover tasks, emit immediately before the frozen death command.
markers.recovered: Emit once a personally viable post-setback state has been restored.
markers.task_complete: Emit when the task objective is judged complete, then wait for the target duration before explicit stop if time remains.
